description: K₃NaMgCr₂O₈ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2 space group. There are two inequivalent K sites. In the first K site, K is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of K-O bond distances ranging from 2.74-3.01 Å. In the second K site, K is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of K-O bond distances ranging from 2.63-3.24 Å. Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent CrO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.88 Å. Mg is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are two shorter (1.99 Å) and two longer (2.01 Å) Mg-O bond lengths. Cr is bonded to four O atoms to form CrO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 7-44°. There are a spread of Cr-O bond distances ranging from 1.68-1.81 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted L-shaped geometry to two equivalent K, one Na, one Mg, and one Cr atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three K, one Na, and one Cr atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to four K, one Na, and one Cr atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two K, one Mg, and one Cr atom.
